player_0.content: New plan: The last episode got aborted because I provided a clue that was too specific and related to only a subset of the target words. Moreover, I included the word "card" in the list of targets, which is not allowed. Next time, I will choose a more general clue that relates to multiple target words, and make sure to exclude the clue word from the list of targets. For example, I could choose the clue word "law" and relate it to the target words "lawyer", "law", and "phone".
